habitat: Reaction-image threads, forum signatures, and novelty apparel racks that assume it is clip art.
diet: Feeds specifically on the belief that hand-drawn equals ownerless.
predators: None natural. The nearest predator is a cease-and-desist, which the species has occasionally attracted despite looking too folkloric to sue over.
transmission: Redrawn and re-traced far more often than reposted intact — unusual for the genus, and part of why its authorship keeps getting lost.
cause_of_death: Presumed public domain by a generation of users who never saw an attribution.
resurrection: Continuous. Never fully buried, because the misconception that killed its authorship also keeps it circulating.
host_population: Anyone drawing a 'troll' anything, including several logos that predate knowing better.
mutation: Countless amateur redraws, none authorized, most already in circulation before anyone thought to ask.
prognosis: Stable at large, unstable at the level of any single infringing use. The species is fine; individual hosts are exposed.
enforcement_history: Copyright registered. Reported licensing income and takedown activity.
curatorial_note: Frequently assumed to be public domain because it looks like clip art. It is not. Good candidate for a wall label about the folk-art fallacy.
